name: Milczący (dawny żołnierz)
description: a silent hermit man about 50, a former soldier, gaunt weathered face, short-cropped grey hair and grey stubble, calm empty staring eyes, a strip of plain white linen tied over his mouth like a gag and knotted at the back of the head, faded patched brown wool tunic, frayed rope belt, grey trousers, worn wrapped leather boots, poor mountain villager, empty hands hanging down, full body, standing, facing the viewer

name: Milcząca (kobieta w chuście)
description: a silent thin woman about 35, pale tired face, long loose dark-brown hair, calm absent gaze, a strip of plain white linen tied over her mouth like a gag and knotted at the back of the head, a plain undyed grey-beige wool dress down to the ankles, a dark brown woollen shawl over her shoulders, barefoot, poor mountain villager, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer

name: Najstarszy z Milczących
description: a very old silent elder about 80, thin and bony, slightly stooped, bald crown with long thin white hair falling to the shoulders and a long white beard, deep wrinkles, a strip of plain white linen tied over his mouth over the beard and knotted at the back of the head, a long faded dark-blue woollen robe with a hood lying on his back, a rope belt, bare thin ankles, worn leather sandals, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer

name: Milcząca (przy grządce)
description: a silent young woman about 20, short-cropped light brown hair, freckles, tired serious eyes, a strip of plain white linen tied over her mouth like a gag and knotted at the back of the head, a simple faded green-grey wool dress with the sleeves rolled up, a brown apron smeared with dry earth, dusty bare forearms, worn brown shoes, poor mountain villager, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
